basics.name: Peter Lawson
basics.label: Building Services Maintenance
basics.summary: Building-services technician with experience across routine HVAC, electrical support and general maintenance. Works within authorization and site procedures and hands over work needing a qualified specialist.

highlights: Completes planned checks on ventilation and building equipment using site procedures.
Supports fault investigation and records observations before work is assigned.
Coordinates access with occupants and external contractors.
Updates maintenance logs and flags repeat faults for review.
Assisted with filter changes, minor repairs and visual electrical checks under supervision.
Prepared tools and materials and kept work areas safe and tidy.
Checked returned equipment, cleaned components and reported damage.
